Options: 
A. The end of the Cold War
B. The Bolshevik Revolution
C. The international recognition of human rights after World War II
D. The invention of the Internet
E. The rise of Fascism
F. The rise of Communism in China
G. Depression of the 1930
H. The advent of the Industrial Revolution
